content.title: Is Aldi Open on Easter 2026? Find Out if Stores Are Open This Sunday
content.text: Is Aldi Open on Easter? Details on 2026 Holiday Hours Planning to do some grocery shopping this Sunday? Here's what to know on Aldi's Easter hours this year.April 4, 2026, 2:00 PM CDTIf your Easter plans include a trip to Aldi, here's what to know about the grocer's holiday hours for 2026.. SOPA Images / Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleSunday, April 5, is Easter. For many people, the holiday is a day dedicated to spending time with family, attending church service or simply taking advantage of spring's long-awaited arrival.Whatever you've got going on this weekend, a trip to the grocery store may be on your to-do list. Whether it's to pick up a few last-minute Easter essentials for brunch or to stock up on necessities ahead of the work week, you may be wondering if Aldi is open on Easter.Given that it's one of the holiest days on the Christian calendar, as well as one of the biggest commemorations of the year, many retailers and restaurants are closed to give employees the opportunity to celebrate with loved ones or enjoy a day off.But what about Aldi? See below to find all the details you need to know about the discount grocery chain's Easter hours this year and whether or not stores will be welcoming customers on the April holiday. As a regular shopper at Aldi, you may already know that the grocery chain is closed on major holidays like Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day. Aldi also operates with adjusted hours on other holidays including Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day.See below to learn more about Aldi's Easter hours for 2026 and whether or not stores will be open this Sunday. According to the Aldi website, all stores will be closed on Easter Sunday. Doors will reopen for business as usual on Monday, April 6. To confirm your local hours or find an Aldi location near you, find a store locator right here. Stores Open on Easter 2026Though Aldi stores will be closed this Sunday, see below for a sampling of retailers that will remain open this Easter or find a complete list right here. BJ’s Wholesale Club: A majority of BJ’s clubs will be open on Easter Sunday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. BJ’s recommends confirming local hours before going. Find local hours here.Dollar General: Stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Home Depot: Stores are open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Hours may vary by location.
